rows.content: the csv importer drops the last row when the file has no trailing newline. find out why

Found it. `splitRows` in `importer/parse.ts` only emits a row when it sees a newline, so a final row without one is never flushed.

Plan:
1. Flush the pending buffer after the loop in `splitRows` when it is non-empty.
2. Leave the quoting logic untouched.
